**Not when:**

- Do not reuse one header primitive only because its typography looks similar.

## Geometry

Margin: child · border: child · padding: child (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Preserve heading and description relationships for the containing surface.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and forced component dimensions (`KUI-L005`).
